title: Public Works ministry unions’ warning strike and gate blockade over performance premium and equipment
location: Ministry of Public Works, Libreville; exact gate/site detail limited
scope: Three of seven ministry unions; geographic extent of action not reported
organizer: Three unions in the Public Works ministry; names not preserved in the opened report summary

occurrence.evidence: Three ministry unions called a warning strike; article reports gate barricading by union members.

date.evidence: The strike began 26 November and lasted three days, reported 29 November.

location.evidence: Gabon Public Works ministry in Libreville; ministry gate was barricaded.

notes: Own-state ministry target and labor demand are present, but no evidence establishes 50 simultaneous participants; preserve the source’s “few” wording without converting it to a numeric estimate.
